items.label: Appointment Book 2026
items.value: This 2026 hourly planner spans the 12 months from Jan 2026 to Dec 2026, featuring monthly and weekly pages. The appointment book also includes a daily breakdown in 30-minute increments from 7 am to 9 pm to keep track of your schedule, offering trendy monthly tabs for a quick glance, measuring 6" x 8". Smart layouts for flawlessly structured days

items.label: Vertical Weekly Layout & Monthly Calendar
items.value: The weekly view has each day broken down in increments of 30 minutes and you can see the entire week across a 2-page spread, which makes scheduling your appointments much easier. Each monthly spread with a large date box helps you easily mark daily hours, schedule appointments, etc

items.label: Additional Planner Features
items.value: Starting with a yearly goals page for goal setting, also featuring reference calendars, a contact page, an important dates page, and holiday lists to keep on top of your special dates. Bonus extra notes pages for capturing everything from little to-dos to big dreams

items.label: Unrivalled Quality
items.value: Unlike other flimsy planners, our 2026 daily planner features a fountain pen friendly paper for easy writing, no ink bleed through. The metal spine that enables the planner to lay flat when open. A sturdy plastic-coated cover, ensuring hold up for the entire year. Monthly tabs for simplifying navigation are laminated to resist tears

items.label: Keep Big Picture in Mind
items.value: How tricky it can be when a thousand appointments buzzing around your head. Discover the ultimate tool for keeping your plan in order. Always feel prepared for the week ahead with our Agenda Book. Perfect size to fit in your backpack, briefcase and take anywhere

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Flexible Plastic, Inner Pocket, Laminated Tabs
